activity_summary: You rehearsed Egeon again, the same man as Monday. You did not turn the morning into a talk about August. Heminges kept that for the call. The afternoon was Egeon again.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the morning to the part.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Held the book back until it was open.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Left the twins to be the funny ones.

entities.name: The Comedy of Errors
entities.context: Mentioned in Egeon, the same man

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Egeon again. The same man as Monday

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not rehearsing a wage into a part
